source: DataNetworks-EWS-Ver1.pdf §7-10 — Risk Indicators (Functional Requirements). 5 KRI families covering the BIL deployment.
notes: T6 M4.1 — initial 25-indicator BIL insurance catalogue. Inputs reference mart.policy_360 / mart.claim_360 / mart.agent_360 etc. which don't materialise yet — those tables ship with the BIL synthetic-data follow-up. Catalog is the contract; compute fns land alongside the data.

indicators.name: address_change_freq_180d
indicators.description: Number of distinct address changes in the customer's profile over the last 180 days. High frequency is a fraud / proxy-policyholder signal.

indicators.name: policy_modification_count_90d
indicators.description: Number of mid-term policy modifications (riders added, sum-assured changed, beneficiary swap) in the last 90 days. Rapid churn correlates with claim manipulation.

indicators.name: premium_payment_bounce_count_180d
indicators.description: Premium debits that bounced (NSF / mandate failure) in the last 180 days. Persistent bounces precede lapse.

indicators.name: high_risk_geography_flag
indicators.description: Customer policy address is in a region flagged on the BIL high-risk geography list (catastrophe / fraud-cluster zones).

indicators.name: premium_discount_pct_above_threshold
indicators.description: Discount applied to the declared standard premium exceeds the BIL underwriting threshold (default 25%). Indicates aggressive sales or under-pricing.

indicators.name: policy_short_duration_flag
indicators.description: Policy was sold with a sub-12-month tenor — shorter than the BIL standard 1-year minimum. Often used to game pre-existing condition exclusions.

indicators.name: policy_count_per_customer_90d
indicators.description: Number of policies issued to the same customer in the last 90 days. Multiple new policies in a short window is a red flag for cumulative-claim abuse.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(policy where customer_id = $cid and issued_at >= now - 90d)

indicators.name: claim_filed_within_waiting_period
indicators.description: Claim submitted within the policy's waiting period (typically 30-90 days from issue). Strong fraud signal.

indicators.name: lifetime_large_claim_count
indicators.description: Number of claims above the BIL large-claim threshold (configurable, default ≥ KES 1M) the customer has filed across all their policies.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(claim where customer_id = $cid and amount >= large_claim_threshold)

indicators.name: kyc_mismatch_flag
indicators.description: Customer's submitted KYC documents have field-level mismatches against their existing profile (DOB / national ID / address). Caught by the KYC vendor's reconciliation pass.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: exists(kyc.mismatch_event where customer_id = $cid and resolved = false)

indicators.name: high_risk_occupation_flag
indicators.description: Customer's declared occupation is on the BIL high-risk occupation list (mining, certain transport, undeclared self-employed cash businesses).

indicators.name: customer_complaint_streak_180d
indicators.description: Number of CRM complaints / disputes raised by the customer in the last 180 days. Pattern correlates with claim-readiness behaviour.

indicators.name: agent_claim_payout_ratio_180d
indicators.description: Sum of claim payouts on policies sold by the agent ÷ sum of premiums collected by the same agent over the last 180 days. High ratio flags potential collusion or moral hazard.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: sum(claim.paid_amount where agent_id = $aid, 180d) / sum(premium where agent_id = $aid, 180d)

indicators.name: agent_high_risk_policy_share_90d
indicators.description: Share of an agent's last-90-days bookings that scored as high-risk by the underwriting engine. Above-portfolio rates signal an agent funnelling risky clients.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(high_risk_policy where agent_id = $aid, 90d) / count(policy where agent_id = $aid, 90d)

indicators.name: agent_lapse_ratio_365d
indicators.description: Share of policies sold by the agent in the last 365 days that lapsed within 6 months of issue. High lapse ratio = poor sales fit OR misselling.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(policy where agent_id = $aid and lapsed_within_180d, 365d) / count(policy where agent_id = $aid, 365d)

indicators.name: agent_policy_clustering_flag
indicators.description: Geographical / demographic clustering: an agent's policies cluster on the same address / phone / family group beyond a normal expected rate. Catches family-fraud rings.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(distinct customer.contact_cluster where agent_id = $aid, 90d) < count(policy where agent_id = $aid, 90d) * cluster_diversity_threshold

indicators.name: repeat_claim_same_reason_180d
indicators.description: Number of claims filed by the same customer with the same primary reason code in the last 180 days. Repeated identical claims warrant manual review.

indicators.name: flagged_hospital_provider_flag
indicators.description: Claim was filed against a hospital / provider on the BIL fraud-watchlist. The watchlist is populated by AML + previous-investigation outcomes.

indicators.name: claim_amount_deviation_pct
indicators.description: Claim amount deviates from the benchmark amount (per reason_code × procedure_code) by more than the BIL deviation threshold (default 30%).

indicators.name: missing_supporting_docs_flag
indicators.description: Claim was submitted without one or more required supporting documents (medical report, FIR, death certificate, etc.). Missing doc = halt + investigate.

indicators.name: claim_documents_off_template_flag
indicators.description: Claim documents fail the BIL template-similarity check vs known fraudulent submissions. Image-similarity vendor flags layout / stamp / signature anomalies.

indicators.name: underwriting_approval_delay_p95_hours
indicators.description: Underwriter's p95 approval-decision latency over the last 30 days. Spikes indicate process congestion or override patterns.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: p95(now - submitted_at where status = 'approved' and underwriter_id = $uid, 30d)

indicators.name: underwriting_override_count_30d
indicators.description: Number of override actions a manager has performed on the underwriting recommendation in the last 30 days. Above-threshold overrides escalate to compliance.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(override where manager_id = $mid and ts >= now - 30d)

indicators.name: suspicious_login_count_30d
indicators.description: Auth events flagged suspicious by the auth-svc rule engine (geo-velocity, device-anomaly, after-hours admin) for an operator over the last 30 days.
indicators.formula_pseudocode: count(auth_event where actor_username = $u and risk_flag = true, 30d)

indicators.name: data_modification_anomaly_flag
indicators.description: Operator has performed a high-impact data modification (sum-assured change, beneficiary swap, claim status manual override) outside their normal pattern over the last 7 days.
